stem: Which sentence best supports the idea that the use of skyscrapers was a practical solution to a problem?

options.label: A
options.text: The need for special equipment and designs meant that building up was costly.

options.label: B
options.text: Some skyscrapers echoed art trends of the past, linking cities to their history.

options.label: C
options.text: Since most cities had limited amounts of land, sites for new houses and offices were scarce and expensive.

options.label: D
options.text: These exciting new buildings gave architects and engineers a chance to demonstrate their skills.
